{
  "dataset_name": "house_16h",
  "model_family": "linear_svm",
  "schema_generator": "claude-sonnet-4.6",
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "features": [
    {
      "name": "log_population_scaled",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Log-transformed population P1 normalized by training mean and std to create a smooth continuous score suitable for linear margins",
      "value_range": [-0.2, 12.0],
      "feature_family": "population_scale",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Compresses heavy-tailed population distribution into approximately normal range, improving linear SVM margin separation",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(np.log1p(P1) - np.log1p(7302.873445501097)) / np.log1p(36688.91078621428)"
    },
    {
      "name": "housing_occupancy_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted composite of housing occupancy indicators H10p1 and H13p1 reflecting overall housing utilization pattern",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "housing_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Combines complementary housing metrics into a single smooth score for linear projection",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "0.6 * H10p1 + 0.4 * H13p1"
    },
    {
      "name": "person_ratio_balance",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of P5p1 to P16p2 capturing relative balance between two person-proportion features, centered around expected equilibrium",
      "value_range": [0.2, 3.5],
      "feature_family": "ratio_features",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ratio captures relative proportional relationships that may be linearly separable in SVM feature space",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "P5p1 / (P16p2 + 1e-6)"
    },
    {
      "name": "housing_vacancy_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Combined vacancy and alternative housing indicator from H2p2 and H8p2, representing degree of non-standard housing",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "housing_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates sparse housing indicators into a denser signal for linear decision boundary",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(H2p2 + H8p2, 0.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "demographic_spread_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Measures spread across demographic proportion features P11p4, P14p9, and P27p4 as a sum of deviations from their training means",
      "value_range": [-0.5, 1.2],
      "feature_family": "demographic_deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Captures joint demographic deviation pattern useful for linear margin in SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "(P11p4 - 0.16290877498171177) + (P14p9 - 0.12077767168983175) + (P27p4 - 0.033415515142648136)"
    },
    {
      "name": "housing_age_mobility_ratio",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Ratio of H18pA to H40p4 capturing relationship between housing age indicator and housing turnover, with smoothing",
      "value_range": [0.0, 5.0],
      "feature_family": "ratio_features",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Ratio of housing characteristics provides a continuous severity measure for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(H18pA / (H40p4 + 0.05), 0.0, 5.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "person_housing_interaction",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Multiplicative interaction between person proportion P15p1 and housing occupancy H10p1 capturing joint high-occupancy signal",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "interaction_features",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Multiplicative interaction approximates a nonlinear relationship in a single linear feature for SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "P15p1 * H10p1"
    },
    {
      "name": "minority_proportion_composite",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Weighted sum of smaller proportion features P6p2, P15p3, and P18p2 representing combined minority-proportion signal",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.5],
      "feature_family": "demographic_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Aggregates sparse low-frequency proportion features into a denser composite for linear separability",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(P6p2 + P15p3 + P18p2 * 10.0, 0.0, 1.5)"
    },
    {
      "name": "housing_stability_score",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Composite stability score combining H10p1 dominance with inverse of vacancy indicators H2p2 and H8p2",
      "value_range": [-1.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "housing_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Smooth signed score of housing stability useful as a linear projection for SVM margin",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip(H10p1 - H2p2 - H8p2, -1.0, 1.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "population_density_deviation",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Signed deviation of log-population from training median expressed in robust units, capturing extreme population areas",
      "value_range": [-3.0, 3.0],
      "feature_family": "population_scale",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Normalized deviation score provides a smooth continuous feature aligned with linear SVM requirements",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "np.clip((np.log1p(P1) - 8.897) / 2.5, -3.0, 3.0)"
    },
    {
      "name": "housing_turnover_severity",
      "type": "judgment",
      "description": "Semantic assessment of housing turnover severity based on H40p4 level: low turnover areas score near 0, high turnover areas score near 1, reflecting market dynamism",
      "value_range": [0.0, 1.0],
      "feature_family": "housing_composite",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Provides a calibrated continuous severity measure of housing market activity for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true
    },
    {
      "name": "demographic_concentration_index",
      "type": "formula",
      "description": "Herfindahl-style concentration index approximation using squared proportions of P5p1 and P15p1 to measure demographic concentration",
      "value_range": [0.1, 1.5],
      "feature_family": "demographic_deviation",
      "expected_model_benefit": "Concentration index captures nonlinear demographic patterns in a single smooth feature for linear SVM",
      "leakage_risk": "low",
      "uses_only_row_values": true,
      "formula": "P5p1 ** 2 + P15p1 ** 2"
    }
  ]
}
